title: SmartSense Monitoring: open-source wireless PT100 node and gateway for surface-temperature monitoring of industrial equipment
description: Design files, firmware, software and analysis scripts of SmartSense Monitoring: battery-powered nodes (Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6, three-wire PT100, MAX31865, Ebyte E220-400T22D LoRa at 433 MHz) and a gateway with touch display and local web dashboard that keeps a rolling 30-day per-sensor history without any cloud service. Hardware (KiCad schematics, BOM, PLA enclosure STL/3MF) is released under CERN-OHL-S v2, firmware and software under MIT, and documentation under CC-BY 4.0; see LICENSES/README.md. Developed as an undergraduate thesis in Electronic Engineering at Universidad ECCI (Bogota, Colombia) and evaluated in a 32-day industrial pilot with three nodes.
